messages:
Maya Patel (recruiter): Quick sync — candidate Priyanka Rao (PM) is scheduled for onsite interviews on 2026-05-20. She requested wheelchair access, a vegan lunch (no dairy), and pre-approved travel reimbursement for Amtrak from Sacramento. Also needs interviews to start at 13:00 due to caregiving. Can people-ops confirm facilities + reimbursement?
Noah Rivera (people ops): I can own reimbursement and the accessibility checklist. @Jules can you confirm ADA access and a quiet room for her 30-min take-home exercise?
Jules (facilities): Yep. We'll reserve Ground Floor conf room A (close to elevator). Will arrange temporary ramp at front entrance and provide keycard for accessible restroom. Quiet room reserved: Room G1 on the same floor. Ramp/install ETA: 2026-05-19 EOD.
recruiter-bot: Attached: /forms/travel-reimb-form.pdf :paperclip: — please have candidate upload receipt within 30 days.
Priyanka Rao (candidate): Thanks — I can bring the Amtrak receipt. Is reimbursement up to $150 okay? I also prefer a boxed vegan lunch and minimal fluorescent lighting for the quiet room.
Noah Rivera (people ops): Approved up to $150. We'll add "minimal lighting" note to room booking and put "vegan boxed lunch (no dairy)" on catering. Priyanka, please upload receipt to the form and reply here once done.
Maya Patel (recruiter): Interviewers: Sam Lee, Priya N., Mark Gutierrez. I'll update calendar invites to 13:00 start and add an accommodations note + directions (ground-floor entrance, meet at reception). Adding a 20-min buffer at the start for check-in and IT setup.
Jules (facilities): Also confirming wheelchair-friendly parking spot reserved (Lot B, space #12) and short ramp from parking to entrance. We'll print a sign at reception with Priyanka's name.
Noah Rivera (people ops): I'll produce an approval email template for reimbursement and cc finance. Maya, can you confirm candidate arrival time so we can schedule a 10-min pickup at reception if needed? :calendar:
Maya Patel (recruiter): Priyanka said arrival by 12:30. I'll send confirmation email now with itinerary, parking spot, and the reimbursment form link. Closing this thread after I post the calendar updates. :thumbsup:
notes: Coordination thread for onsite accessibility, travel reimbursement, and interview scheduling for candidate Priyanka Rao. Includes facility actions, catering and parking details, and attachment for reimbursement form.
